prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1045; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while it was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently receiving medical care.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Should you need to speak with our client for any reason, you must first obtain our written consent.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page, within thirty days of receipt of this letter.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision, including photographs, vehicle data, claim files, recorded statements, dashcam or surveillance footage, and any repair or inspection records. Destruction or alteration of such evidence may result in serious consequences for your insured and your company.
